title: TestAtlas Report
description: Schema for reports/REPORT-*.{md,json} (PRD §20). Accepts both V1 (legacy — string-array sections) and V2 (current — object-array sections + 15 named composite sections per generate-report.js).

runSummary.description: Run summary. V1 emitted a single string; V2 emits an object with section-shaped fields.

kind.description: V2: report kind (e.g. 'snapshot', 'release-readiness', 'domain', 'trend'). Emitted by generate-report.js.

priorReport.description: V2: pointer to the previous report this report compares against (null for baseline).

generationMode.description: V2: how the report was generated ('script', 'subagent-aggregate', 'human-edited', etc.).

environmentsCovered.description: V1: list of environments the run executed against. V2 reports may omit and use 'coverage.environments' instead.

domainsCovered.description: V1: list of domains exercised. V2 reports may omit and use 'coverage.domains' instead.

flowsCovered.description: V1: list of flows exercised. V2 reports may omit and use 'coverage.flows' instead.

testsExecuted.description: V1: tests-executed count. V2 reports may omit and use 'runSummary.tests' or 'coverage.tests' instead.

evidenceCount.description: V1: evidence-records count. V2 reports may omit and use 'evidenceCatalogSummary.total' instead.

coverage.description: V2: composite coverage section (domains × flows × environments × tests). Heterogeneous; downstream UIs interpret.

severityBreakdown.description: V2: count of issues by severity at report-time.

confidenceBreakdown.description: V2: count of issues by confidence at report-time.

regressions.description: V2: regression detections in the reporting window.

qualityRisks.description: V2: enumerated quality risks surfaced by the report.

evidenceCatalogSummary.description: V2: aggregate counts + freshness for the evidence catalog.

capabilityDegradation.description: V2: capability-degradation notes (per bootstrap.md §4). May be an object or an array of objects.

trendVsPrior.description: V2: delta-vs-priorReport summary (regression count delta, severity-load delta, coverage delta).

runLogTail.description: V2: tail entries from history/run_log.md so the report is self-contained. Accepts an array of objects (machine-readable) OR a string (free-form prose summary or pointer to the canonical md file).

readinessRationale.description: V2: free-form rationale supporting the readinessAssessment verdict (cited tallies, blockers list, etc.).

keyFindings.description: Key findings list. V1 emitted strings; V2 emits objects ({id, summary, evidence[], confidence}).

highestSeverityIssues.description: V1: issue-id list. V2 reports surface the same info via 'severityBreakdown' / 'blockers'.

blockers.description: Blocker list. V1 emitted strings; V2 emits objects.

gaps.description: Gap list. V1 emitted strings; V2 emits objects.

assumptions.description: Assumption list. V1 emitted strings; V2 emits objects.

recommendedNextActions.description: Next-action list. V1 emitted strings; V2 emits objects.

retestRecommendations.description: Retest-recommendation list (V1). V2 reports surface this via 'regressions' or 'recommendedNextActions'.

readinessAssessment.description: Readiness verdict. V1: free-form string. V2: enum-or-string ('ship-ready' | 'needs-work' | 'blocked' | other).
